title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
lineage: source 1: SBD>MR>R>R>D>CD>EAC>SHN; source 2: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN; source 3: AUD>MR>C>C>C>CD>EAC>SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures a high‑energy Jerry’s birthday show, highlighted by a smoking Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes → Morning Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a crisp, well‑balanced board‑plus‑audience blend that lets the band’s fireworks shine.  Jerry’s birthday performance is “smoking” from start to finish, with the Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes > Morning Dew suite standing out as one of ’73’s classic moments.  A few early glitches and a muddy bass low‑end are noted, but they don’t detract from an overall high‑energy, memorable set.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (majority 4–5 stars) praise both the performance and the recording; occasional technical complaints are outweighed by consistent acclaim for the show’s energy and the superb Dark Star suite.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix that blends board clarity with audience ambience; early‑set glitches mentioned by a few reviewers, occasional bass mud, but overall superb soundstage and drum presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless transitions, especially the Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes → Morning Dew sequence; high‑energy second set keeps momentum strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Birthday night brilliance – sizzling guitar tone, leading four of five consecutive tunes, and a “smoking” solo throughout the Dark Star suite.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass drives the pre‑verse jam on Dark Star; described as “in top form,” providing funky, tight grooves that anchor the improvisation.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mixed remarks – some call his playing “whacked,” but overall contributes solid rhythm and vocal work to the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith delivers tasteful fills in the chorus of Eyes and adds color throughout; praised for “fantastic touch.”
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s drums are louder than usual in the mix, offering a punchy, crisp foundation that many reviewers highlighted as a positive change.
